# @fyit/crouton-maps

> MapLibre GL integration (@geoql/v-maplibre) with map components, markers, Nominatim geocoding, and OpenFreeMap style presets — no API key required. Used by crouton-bookings for location maps.

AI hint: use when app has location features or map displays

## Components

- `CroutonMapsCurrentLocationButton`: Button that finds the user's current location and reverse-geocodes it
- `CroutonMapsMap`: Main map container with MapLibre GL (@geoql/v-maplibre, OpenFreeMap tiles)
- `CroutonMapsMarker`: Map marker with optional popup text and drag support
- `CroutonMapsPopup`: Map popup with custom slot content
- `CroutonMapsPreview`: Location preview thumbnail with modal — used in collection list cells

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useCurrentLocation`
- `useGeocode`
- `useMapConfig`
- `useMapStyles`
- `useMarkerColor`
